questions.prompt: Which of these are kinds of poem?
questions.fact: A haiku is seventeen sounds long. A fresco is painted into wet plaster and a sonata is played, not written down as verse.

questions.prompt: Which of these are gods in Norse myth?
questions.fact: Thursday is Thor's day and Wednesday is Odin's, under his other name, Woden.

questions.prompt: How old was Tutankhamun when he died?
questions.fact: About nineteen. He was a minor pharaoh and was only famous because his tomb was the one nobody had robbed.

questions.prompt: In which year did the first Harry Potter film come out?
questions.fact: The books had sold so well by then that the studio was told the cast had to be British, and it was.

questions.prompt: Which country hosted the 2000 Summer Olympics?
questions.hint: The harbour and the opera house were on every broadcast.
questions.fact: Sydney built its main stadium to hold 110,000 people, the biggest in Olympic history, then shrank it afterwards.

questions.prompt: Which nut is marzipan made from?
questions.hint: The same nut as amaretto and frangipane.
questions.fact: Ground almonds and sugar, and nothing else in the traditional recipe. It is older than the sugar trade in Europe.
